name: Oshama Popup
author: oshama

sections.description:
Oshama Popup is a lightweight yet extremely powerful popup plugin for WordPress. It gives you total control over how, when, and where your popups appear on your site. With options for responsive images, custom HTML, and responsive self-hosted or embedded videos (including vertical short formats), this builder provides premium functionalities out of the box.

Key Features

  • Highly Responsive Designs: Popups look stunning on desktop, tablets, and mobile devices alike.
  • Separated Video Heights: Customize video display height for desktop and mobile devices separately.
  • Vertical Short Video Support: Supports vertical video aspect ratios and automated muted looping for portrait format screens.
  • Targeting & Logic Rules: Show popups sitewide, only on the homepage, or target specific posts/pages. Target logged-in or logged-out users.
  • Scheduling: Schedule your popups to automatically start and end at specific date and time ranges.
  • Conversion Analytics: In-built tracking of popup impressions and conversions. Easily analyze your click-through rates.
  • Import/Export: Move popups across websites smoothly using JSON data files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/oshama-popup directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Popup Builder’ menu in the WP admin bar to create, modify, and monitor your popups.
